description: 福岡県 土砂災害警戒区域等のshapeデータ [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 福岡県. 福岡県に関係する土砂災害警戒区域等のshapeデータです。. Coverage: 福岡県. The portal files it under the publisher 福岡県. Its tags are 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-07-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
